title: Factors of a monomial in a complete saturated monoid local model
statement: Let $P$ be a finitely generated integral saturated commutative monoid [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], written additively, and suppose it is sharp, meaning that $0$ is its only invertible element. Let $n\geq0$ be an integer. For a coefficient ring $L$, write $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ for the ring of finite sums of symbols $c z^q t^e$, with $q\in P$, $e\in\mathbf N^n$, $c\in L$, and multiplication $z^qz^{q'}=z^{q+q'}$. If $L$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_L$, let $B_L(P,n)$ be its completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] at $(\mathfrak m_L,z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. Let $R$ be one of the following rings: (i) $B_k(P,n)$ for a field $k$; (ii) $B_C(P,n)/(\theta)$ for a Cohen ring $C$ of residue characteristic $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $\theta-p\in(z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)B_C(P,n)$. In case (ii), $p$ is prime and the residue field of $C$ is arbitrary of characteristic $p$. Write $z^q\in R$ for the image of the indicated monomial. For every $q\in P$ and $b,c\in R$ with $bc=z^q$, there are $r\in P$ and a unit $u\in R^\times$ such that $b=u z^r$. This includes $q=0$, $P=\{0\}$ and $n=0$.

source.place: Algebraic sublemma for Expose VI 1.4, printed p. 69, after the complete models of VI 1.6, printed p. 70; agent-stated complete-ring monomial-factor lemma. The underlying reference for divisorial recognition is Kato (1994), Theorem 11.6, cited by Niziol (2006), Proposition 2.6; these documents are WANTED locally (report.md). The complete-ring factor lemma is left unsplit, not claimed to have a proof in VIII 3.5.
